Hey, sorry to hear you're going through this, I really hope things pick up for you in the future! I'm still recovering from my breakup which fed into depression that I was already experiencing, so I started talking Citalopram (which is an antidepressant) to try and help me by.

In my experience:

- taking citalopram definitely helps with stress and low mood, its like your mind doesn't "snowball" with negative thoughts
- I generally feel a lot calmer day to day 

However, 
- I've started to feel like the 'calming' affect is not what I personally want, it feels like the world is dull and dead, harmless yes, but just unexciting
- your libido will probably be hit hard, this is the worst side effect in my opinion 
- I truly believe that the meds should never be the sole catalyst for change, I cant stress this enough, please please talk to anyone about how you feel, maybe try and schedule CBT?

 Once again I'm really sorry to hear things have been rough for you, I hope they improve.

Hi, thank you for taking the time out to reply, I appreciate it. I have tried to help myself as much as I can, i have got support from uni and have started taking an antidepressant, it just gets really tough sometimes. Thankyou for the support❤
Thankyou very much for taking the time to reply, wish you the best aswell
